answers.core: The reason I feel this should be in the core is that it deals with the fundamentals of 3D interaction via colliders. I propose that many developers are using the collider generators as a means to speed up the development of simple game fundamentals and this tool would give them a free performance and safety boost.
answers.workaround: I propose that for a heavy number of use cases, a simple box collider would be more beneficial for mesh objects, especially static ones. I think that this feature will be used very often.

title: Add "Create boundary cube collision sibling" option for mesh
